examples.arabic: جدتي فاطمة وأنا قررنا نروح نتسوق بالسوق القديم هذاك اليوم، عشان نلاقي أشياء حلوة لبيتنا.
examples.english: My grandmother Fatima and I decided to go shopping in the old souk that day, to find nice things for our home.
examples.transliteration: Jiddati Fatima w ana qarrarna nrouh ntsawwaq bil-souq il-qadeem hadak il-yom, 'ashan nla'i ashyaa' hilweh l-baytna.
examples.storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

examples.arabic: المعلمة ليلى قالت إنها بتشتاق لصفها القديم ومكتبها الخشبي المريح.
examples.english: Teacher Laila said that she misses her old classroom and her comfortable wooden desk.
examples.transliteration: el-mu-allime Laila qalet in-ha btishtaq la-saff-ha el-qadim wa maktab-ha el-khashabi el-muriih.
examples.storyTitle: The Voice of Hope from the Heart of the School

examples.arabic: بيوم من الإيام، جدو أعطاه كتاب قديم ومغبر.
examples.english: One day, his grandfather gave him an old and dusty book.
examples.transliteration: Be-yom min al-iyam, jiddo ataah ktab qadeem wa mghabbar.

examples.arabic: ببنفس اللحظة، هدي صوت الرصاص وطلع من المذياع القديم خبر عن هدنة مفاجئة بتبشر بنهاية سنين القهر والوجع.
examples.english: At that same moment, the sound of bullets calmed down and news came out of the old radio about a sudden ceasefire promising the end of years of oppression and pain.
examples.transliteration: Bi-nafs al-laHza, hidi sawt al-rasas wa-tala min al-midya al-qadim khabar an hudna mufaji'a b-tbashshir bi-nihayat sinin al-qahr wal-waja.
examples.storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

examples.arabic: بينما كنت عم اتمشى بالسوق القديم لمحت وجه مالوف ما شفته من اكتر من عشر سنين
examples.english: While I was walking in the old market, I caught sight of a familiar face I hadn't seen for over ten years.
examples.transliteration: baynama kint aam atamashsha bissuuq alqadiim lamahat wihj maaluuf ma shifto min aktar min aashar sniin

examples.english: Suddenly I saw my old friend Ahmed!
